## How this relates to `patches/manifest.json`

The manifest stays as the *registry* of verified byte changes — that is
what `tools/patch.py` uses to record and verify a change against a local
exe. It is a development tool and it hardcodes one developer's exe path,
so it is not shippable. This pack is the shippable form of the same
changes. **The manifest is the source; regenerate the pack after
registering a new patch:**

```bash
python tools/build_pack.py build
```
